mapper.insert: insert into builder.adk_builder_dev_request_delivery (id, dev_request_id, delivery_key, body_fingerprint, outcome, requested_by) values (#{id}, #{devRequestId}, #{deliveryKey}, #{bodyFingerprint}, #{outcome}, #{requestedBy,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.update: update builder.adk_builder_dev_request_delivery set outcome = #{outcome}, http_status = #{httpStatus,jdbcType=INTEGER}, response_id = #{responseId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, failure = #{failure,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, finished_at = now() where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select id, dev_request_id, delivery_key, body_fingerprint, outcome, http_status, response_id, failure, requested_by, started_at, finished_at from builder.adk_builder_dev_request_delivery where dev_request_id = #{devRequestId} order by started_at desc, id desc
mapper.update: update builder.adk_builder_dev_request set delivery_state = #{outcome}, development_state = case when #{outcome} = 'SENT' then 'INTAKE' else development_state end, development_checked_at = case when #{outcome} = 'SENT' then null else development_checked_at end, development_sync_error = case when #{outcome} = 'SENT' then null else development_sync_error end, development_merged_sha = case when #{outcome} = 'SENT' then null else development_merged_sha end, development_merged_at = case when #{outcome} = 'SENT' then null else development_merged_at end, updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and delivery_state = 'SENDING'
